physicalNotes: Radius 0.19448691 Jupiter radii from González-Álvarez et al. 2023 (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A.177G/abstract): 13,904.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0230313 Jupiter masses (González-Álvarez et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A.177G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.shape: González-Álvarez et al. 2023 (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GONZ_AACUTE_LEZ__AACUTE_LVAREZ_ET_AL__2023): a/R* 13.05; González-Álvarez et al. 2023 (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GONZ_AACUTE_LEZ__AACUTE_LVAREZ_ET_AL__2023): inclination 87.42 degrees

sources.phase: González-Álvarez et al. 2023 (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GONZ_AACUTE_LEZ__AACUTE_LVAREZ_ET_AL__2023): transit mid-time 2458766.4702 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 5 min)
